objective.text: Close the single open tracker step of orders that already carry a filed claim (Bentham rank 8, production.one_step_away, 219 orders; mostly an unresolved first-end date) and recover the custody-stranded and stale-working-text orders (ranks 6-7), by complete new claims from held sources or precise blocks, raising orders ready for human review. Scripted Claude coordination: four producer lanes in this cloud session and four in a Claude Code session on the owner's PC, on disjoint packets, one shared review and filing path; one measurement probe (Gilbreth) records per-call usage, per-step time and read sizes so later waves can be made cheaper.

premortem.failure: Producer lanes plus kit apply and batch-check overload the 2-CPU cloud container or the two hosts diverge
premortem.guard: at most 4 lanes on each host; the PC lanes work in their own git worktree on disjoint packets prepared there, and hand back only their packet folders by branch; the cloud coordinator alone runs review, reveal and filing on main

premortem.failure: A correction copies the old claim's unsupported sentences, so reviewers uphold a claim that repeats a defect
premortem.guard: the correction route requires a complete new claim checked against held bytes; two blind Opus arms review every submission and planted controls in every review set; a claim files only if both arms uphold

premortem.failure: Spend runs past the cap because first-end research is open-ended
premortem.guard: block-at-once rule for any source not held; Bentham gate after every batch with stop on STOP; coordinator ledger stops new launches when measured spend plus the next step forecast would pass 150 USD

premortem.failure: Lanes collide on orders or files
premortem.guard: each packet's ids are disjoint, reserved under the wave's claim-kit agent name through kit.py's lock guard, and each worker writes only inside its own packet folder and scratch folder

acknowledged_findings.F-20261118-kiaer-stopped-at-review: Every guard names code the coordinator runs and the owner can open: prep.sh (kit.py prepare with dispatch check, cruden lookups, Geddes views), kit apply and batch-check, review_prep.py controls, finish_pair.py; the budget is sized from Papinian and Bartolus measured per-order costs, not a guess.
acknowledged_findings.F-20261112-lind-stage0-diagnosis: No undecided orders in this wave; every submission passes the actual claim checker inside batch-check before any review session, and custody is checked at prepare (dispatch) and again by batch-check.
acknowledged_findings.F-20261112-lind-stage0: Not the undecided route; custody of ending sources is settled at prepare and batch-check before review; coordination is scripted (prep.sh, render_producer.py, review_prep.py, finish_pair.py) and the coordinator reads only handbacks and failures.
acknowledged_findings.F-20261110-mommsen-unranked-pools: Only Bentham-ranked actions (ranks 6, 7, 8), taken in rank order; claim-kit admission refuses any order outside the named action; the Bentham gate runs after every batch and STOP ends the wave.
acknowledged_findings.F-20261108-cujas-photius-recheck: The producer brief requires reconciling every held FR 'Revoked by' or 'Superseded by' note; corrections replace own claims under agent claude; jobs/** and the rule folders are checked out before prepare.
acknowledged_findings.F-20261107-haloander-undecided-probe: No undecided stratum: every order already has an adopted provisional status and a filed claim, and the rate is Bentham's measured correction rate (53 of 83).
acknowledged_findings.F-20261104-sol-runtime-economy-rejected: Packets, applied versions, review receipts and the Gilbreth probe's raw measurements are kept as written and committed; nothing is sealed from a summary.
acknowledged_findings.F-20261104-5: A source held only as a hash is a block at batch-check under the brief; YES corrections need a held current-law predicate; NEA continuation notices and EO 13286 are now held.
acknowledged_findings.F-20261104-2: Recovery.custody_stranded orders get a new prepare for exactly those ids, custody preflight runs at prepare, and every claim gets a fresh two-arm review; no reuse of old review receipts.
acknowledged_findings.F-20261103-bacon-recovery: All artifacts are written to the wave folder in the repository and committed by PR at each batch end, not kept in chat or local-only bundles.
acknowledged_findings.F-20261029-codex-proquest-census: Producers work from the kit's pinned held bytes and effective versions; any held order or block is preserved as written, and blocks name the exact missing source.
acknowledged_findings.F-20261028-4: Every packet is prepared fresh from the current claim kit on main at wave start.
acknowledged_findings.F-20261018-7: Producers fetch no new hosts; they work only from held texts in each dossier, and the forecast uses Bentham's measured rates.
